captions.detailed: A classic 19th-century garrison siege cannon featuring a heavy, dark-grey cast-iron barrel mounted on a brown wooden carriage. The wooden carriage is supported by four spoked iron-shod wheels, with two smaller wheels at the rear and two larger wheels at the front. The cylindrical barrel is balanced on side cheeks and can elevate or depress relative to the carriage, while a small wooden quoin wedge slides underneath the rear breech to adjust and lock the elevation angle.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a Civil War garrison siege cannon. It must feature a heavy cylindrical iron barrel, a wooden carriage assembly with four spoked wheels, and a sliding quoin wedge for elevation adjustments. Ensure the barrel is capable of rotating on its trunnions and the wheels can spin on their axles.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. The main carriage frame is built using box shapes for the side cheeks and crossbeams, styled in a dark brown wood material. The four wheels are modeled using cylinders for the rims, hubs, and spokes, attached to the carriage via continuous joints. The main barrel is constructed from a series of concentric cylinders and a sphere for the cascable, colored in a dark iron grey. It is connected to the carriage using a revolute joint representing the trunnions, and a prismatic sliding block represents the elevation quoin wedge underneath the breech.
